mapper.select: SELECT col.id AS collectId, col.create_time AS collectTime, p.id AS productId, p.name, CONCAT(#{baseUrl}, p.img_dir, p.main_img) AS mainImg, p.sales, p.stock, p.cue_type AS cueType, pr.platform_price AS platformPrice, pr.official_price AS officialPrice FROM collection col LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id = col.product_id LEFT JOIN product_price pr ON pr.product_id = p.id WHERE col.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY col.create_time DESC
